Thats not really true  that ppl of the ph do not emidiatly ask for a handout. My wife is pinay and ive been in ph a few times. I agree they are friendly, quick to smile  and rich in love.  Begging however is frequent. Young kids and old ladies where the most common beggars in ph in my experience. The old ppl who dont have a family to take care of them as they grow old. My experience aswell was that phillippines is/was dirty, trash everywhere and the effect of pullotion and enviroment destruction showed clearly. I did not visit a resort with white sand and blue ocean i saw the real life of rural phillepines where ppl who are poor eat dogs  and most everything else. I saw the absolute powerty and missary that some pinoy/pinay live in. And the beggars they had noone, they where labeld aeta by pinoy with stable income, aeta is ph indiginous ppl much like aboriginal ppl. So the comradery that is talked about in the videos is real in ph but its not for everyone, its not for the poorest of the poor pinoy = beggars, they whe4e seen as little more value than the streetdogs that they eat. 

So this video is higly romanticized, and not really untrue but also not true. Ph is soo so beautiful, i long to go back there almost every day, but its also dirty, its poor, its behind and backwards and ph needs massive social, economic, environmental reforms.. ph need to have a wellfaresystem that works, they need social instututions for the old and the sick to have a place to live and be cared for, it needs a medical system that works where "normal" pinoy can afford to go to docktor without selling an arm or a leg or having to rely on insurance from the employer. The countryside need to have standardised vauges so there is no manila rate or countryside rate when it comes to salary. Who would want to work 8h a day for a salary 4000 peso a month??? Ph needs infrastructure to take care of and collect garabge so it does not end up in the ocean?

I am not criticizing any pinoy/pinay (except if you are a dog eater, if you can eat man's best friend then you are not human) i am however very critical towards phillipine gouverment system and the lack of care for its citizens. To meet it seems as soon as someone gets a bit ahead they start to grab what they can to ensure their and their family first meaning corruption. Anyway I love phillepines and most of its ppl but this my honest weiv and experience of ph aswell.
